# UrukCode (Uruk code)

> Free, open-source QR code and barcode generator that runs entirely in your browser. No signup, no server, no data ever leaves the device.

UrukCode — also searched as "Uruk code" — creates QR codes (URL, plain text, WiFi, vCard, email, phone, SMS, GPS location) and barcodes (CODE128, CODE39, CODE93, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14, ITF, MSI, Pharmacode, Codabar), decodes QR codes from uploaded images, and exports results as PNG or SVG files.

## Key facts

- Price: free forever — no signup, no account, no usage limits
- Privacy: 100% client-side processing; content is never uploaded to a server
- Tracking: none — no analytics cookies and no third-party tracking
- Export formats: PNG and SVG
- QR types: text, URL, WiFi, vCard, email, phone, SMS, GPS location
- Barcode formats: 12+ (CODE128, CODE39, CODE93, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14, ITF, MSI, Pharmacode, Codabar)
- QR decoding: yes — upload PNG/JPG/WebP, read locally
- License: MIT (open source)
- Author: Umaer Islam — https://umaerislam.com
- Source code: https://github.com/umaer-islam/urukcode
- Live site: https://umaer-islam.github.io/urukcode/

## FAQ (short answers)

- Is UrukCode free? Yes — 100% free, MIT-licensed, no limits or watermarks.
- Does UrukCode upload my data? No — everything runs in the browser; there is no backend.
- Do I need an account? No signup or installation required.
- Can it decode a QR code from an image? Yes — the Decode QR tab reads PNG/JPG/WebP locally.
- Does it work offline? Yes — after the page loads, generation works without a server.
